gpu_load_observation.note: Two-second GPU process observations; short-lived processes may exit before identity lookup. Host is not reserved.

block_calibration.note: Prediction from measured complete-target wall time; pauses excluded. New jobs only.

lifecycle.visibility_remap: queue 1 retained its UUID at visible ordinal 0

limitations: Finite-job rates include process startup/self-tests/durability/shutdown; they are not kernel timings.
Twelve-hour widths are predictions from five warmed validated reference grants, not twelve-hour runs.
Live stalls use SIGSTOP; no actual driver hang or hardware reset was induced.
Memory pressure constrains host preparation; device-memory refusal is covered separately by backend tests.
MIG, public ingress and distributed coordinator/worker traffic across hosts were not exercised.
No additional GPU workload was launched alongside the measured fleet; unrelated host load is uncontrolled.
JIT preload experiment measures fresh worker self-test wall time only; no default or kernel tuning changed.
